'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tim Heffner LS Agents In The Court''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tim Heffner]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|JPSD-L-agentsinthecourt.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Jawa Swarm
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
